up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL215 (Polyunsaturated fatty acid 5-lipoxygenase). The target must be of type 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Only include rows with standard_relation = '=' (exact values) and non-null pChEMBL values. For each qualifying activity, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type (target_type), target tax_id (tax_id), canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (which will be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the results to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL215' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
